title: ErrorEnvelope v1
description: Body of every non-2xx API response (ARCH-R015). Codes come from specs/contracts/error_codes.v1.yaml. Messages are plain language and never contain SQL, stack traces, secrets, submitted values or names of out-of-scope entities (ARCH-R025). Bootstrap contract (ADR-0004 §1), frozen by CF-0.

code.description: Registry code (error_codes.v1.yaml). The pattern, not an enum, constrains it so later milestones can add codes additively.

requestRef.description: Server-assigned reference of the HTTP request (ARCH-R020); also sent in the X-Request-Ref header.

retryable.description: True when retrying the same request may succeed (for example DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE).

details.description: Optional structured detail, used by VALIDATION_ERROR. Never echoes submitted values.

path.description: Location of the problem, for example body.principalId or query.limit.

rule.description: Violated rule, for example required, unknown_field, max_value.

error.message: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again.
